\u27e6CODE1\u27e7: ["```python title=\"instrument_pydantic_ai.py\" hl_lines=\"1 5 6\"", "import logfire", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "", "logfire.configure()  # (1)!", "logfire.instrument_pydantic_ai()  # (2)!", "", "agent = Agent('openai:gpt-6.1-sol', name='hello_world_agent', instructions='Be concise, reply with one sentence.')  # (4)!", "result = agent.run_sync('Where does \"hello world\" come from?')  # (3)!", "print(result.output)", "\"\"\"", "The first known use of \"hello, world\" was in a 1974 textbook about the C programming language.", "\"\"\"", "```"]
\u27e6CODE2\u27e7: ["```python title=\"with_logfire_instrument_httpx.py\" hl_lines=\"7\"", "import logfire", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "", "logfire.configure()", "logfire.instrument_pydantic_ai()", "logfire.instrument_httpx(capture_all=True)  # (1)!", "", "agent = Agent('openai:gpt-6.1-sol')", "result = agent.run_sync('What is the capital of France?')", "print(result.output)", "#> The capital of France is Paris.", "```"]
\u27e6CODE3\u27e7: ["```python title=\"otel_tui.py\" hl_lines=\"7 8\"", "import os", "", "import logfire", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "", "os.environ['OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT'] = 'http://localhost:4318'  # (1)!", "logfire.configure(send_to_logfire=False)  # (2)!", "logfire.instrument_pydantic_ai()", "logfire.instrument_httpx(capture_all=True)", "", "agent = Agent('openai:gpt-6.1-sol')", "result = agent.run_sync('What is the capital of France?')", "print(result.output)", "#> Paris", "```"]
\u27e6CODE5\u27e7: ["```python title=\"raw_otel.py\"", "import os", "", "from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.http.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter", "from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider", "from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor", "from opentelemetry.trace import set_tracer_provider", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "", "os.environ['OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT'] = 'http://localhost:4318'", "exporter = OTLPSpanExporter()", "span_processor = BatchSpanProcessor(exporter)", "tracer_provider = TracerProvider()", "tracer_provider.add_span_processor(span_processor)", "", "set_tracer_provider(tracer_provider)", "", "Agent.instrument_all()", "agent = Agent('openai:gpt-6.1-sol')", "result = agent.run_sync('What is the capital of France?')", "print(result.output)", "#> Paris", "```"]
\u27e6CODE6\u27e7: ["```python", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai.models.instrumented import InstrumentationSettings", "", "Agent.instrument_all(InstrumentationSettings(use_aggregated_usage_attribute_names=False))", "```"]
